author: Cbox
description: Generated from the Cbox Billing OpenAPI contract, with a hot-path enforcement client (leases, entitlements, features), webhook verification, pagination and typed errors.

author: Riccardo Zanotelli
description: Mountable Rails engine to inspect and operate Solid Queue: jobs by state, filtered by job class and sortable by column (Ransack), failed job retry/discard, queues pause/resume, recurring tasks and processes. Plain HTML tables, light and dark theme, polling refresh, no front-end dependencies.

description: Ruby client and worker for LessorMQ, the message queue over HTTP where the server decides and clients only claim, run, ack or fail

author: LessorMQ
description: ActiveJob adapter and worker for LessorMQ: the queue decides retries, delays and dead-lettering; Rails only enqueues and runs jobs

author: Yevhenii Hurin
description: Reads a gem's own documentation with YARD — its source comments and the prose files it ships — and writes it as Markdown pages, one per class or module, made to be read and searched by people and coding agents.
